Data quality per recording or epoch

Source: R/quality.R
g3_quality.Rd

Counts the samples of each recording or epoch and how many of them hold data, for example to find trials with too much missing data before analysis.

Usage

g3_quality(x, by = NULL)

Arguments

x

Gaze data from read_g3_gaze() or g3_epochs(). Long pupil data from g3_pupil_long() are not accepted, because each sample is there twice.

by

Names of further columns to group by, such as a condition column. They are kept in the result.

Value

A tibble with one row per group, starting with the grouping columns, and these columns:

samples

Number of samples.

duration

Seconds from the first to the last sample.

valid

Proportion of samples with a gaze point.

valid_left, valid_right

Proportion of samples with data for each eye, if x has these columns.

max_gap

Longest time in seconds between two samples with a gaze point. The first and last samples of the group count as boundaries, so missing data at the start or end are included. In complete data it is the sample interval, 0.02 s at 50 Hz. Damaged lines skipped by the readers also lengthen it.

Samples without a time count towards samples and the proportions, but not towards duration and max_gap. A grouped tibble keeps its groups.

Details

Rows are grouped by the recording and epoch columns where these exist, so the function works on the output of read_g3_gaze(), g3_epochs() and g3_fill_gaps(). Columns named in by are added to these groups, and so are the groups of a grouped tibble. Rows inserted by g3_fill_gaps() count as samples without data.

Examples

rec <- read_g3(g3_example())
g3_quality(rec$gaze)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 7
#>   recording samples duration valid valid_left valid_right max_gap
#>   <chr>       <int>    <dbl> <dbl>      <dbl>       <dbl>   <dbl>
#> 1 recording    1497     30.0 0.907      0.848       0.803   0.260

ep <- g3_epochs(rec$gaze, rec$events, before = 0.5, after = 3, direction = "out")
quality <- g3_quality(ep)
quality
#> # A tibble: 5 × 8
#>   recording epoch samples duration valid valid_left valid_right max_gap
#>   <chr>     <int>   <int>    <dbl> <dbl>      <dbl>       <dbl>   <dbl>
#> 1 recording     1     153     3.05 0.922      0.850       0.817  0.220 
#> 2 recording     2     175     3.49 0.88       0.829       0.789  0.220 
#> 3 recording     3     175     3.49 0.88       0.851       0.857  0.220 
#> 4 recording     4     174     3.47 0.954      0.908       0.776  0.180 
#> 5 recording     5     175     3.49 1          0.971       0.977  0.0201
dplyr::filter(quality, valid >= 0.8, max_gap < 0.5)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 8
#>   recording epoch samples duration valid valid_left valid_right max_gap
#>   <chr>     <int>   <int>    <dbl> <dbl>      <dbl>       <dbl>   <dbl>
#> 1 recording     1     153     3.05 0.922      0.850       0.817  0.220 
#> 2 recording     2     175     3.49 0.88       0.829       0.789  0.220 
#> 3 recording     3     175     3.49 0.88       0.851       0.857  0.220 
#> 4 recording     4     174     3.47 0.954      0.908       0.776  0.180 
#> 5 recording     5     175     3.49 1          0.971       0.977  0.0201
